items.title: From warehouses to factories: The changing face of defense
items.summary: A flexible defense ecosystem does more than respond to crises. It builds long-term resilience. That means diversified supply chains, evolving modular platforms, and designed systems that don’t just work today, but adapt to tomorrow.

items.title: Three strategies for health data interoperability success
items.summary: Government and commercial health organizations realize that being data driven leads to better decisions and more impactful outcomes. It is critical for quality care, and is directly dependent on the interoperability of health data.

items.title: Navigating the integration of AI with anti-money laundering
items.summary: This CGI blog post covers key considerations in navigating the integration of artificial intelligence with anti-money laundering.

items.title: Why getting your data in order is key to enabling “speed to trusted action” for the energy transition
items.summary: Utilities are dealing with exponential growth in the volume and complexity of data. At the same time, they are readying for the energy transition by preparing networks to support electrification and increased use of renewable energy resources, like wind, solar and tidal, which are intermittent and less dependable. To be successful, utility leaders need to make the right decisions at the right time. This requires data to be at the heart of the decision-making process. It must be accurate, reliable, complete, relevant and timely to help guide and prioritize decisions.

items.title: Transforming health and care experiences and outcomes
items.summary: Our health and care industry is in urgent need of transforming the way it delivers services and measures outcomes. Although individuals may have multiple conditions, both chronic and acute, transformation is possible if carried out in a graceful, inclusive, way that addresses patient and citizen needs.

items.title: The future of financial messaging: Adaptive, sovereign and continuously resilient
items.summary: Discover how adaptive, sovereign and resilient financial messaging can help banks modernize payments, reduce risk and stay future-ready.

items.title: ‘Greenwashing’ is a bad strategy; we need sustainable finance
items.summary: This CGI blog post discusses the need and opportunities for sustainable finance.

items.title: Singapore to Seattle in seconds: The upcoming reality of cross-border instant payments
items.summary: CGI’s Ainsley Ward shares insights on the evolution of cross-border instant payments and new opportunities for banks.

items.title: Two artificial intelligence must-haves: An innovation culture and data literacy
items.summary: In my work as a data scientist, I have a front seat view of the power of artificial intelligence (AI) in turning vast data into actionable insights—insights that transform how organizations operate and the outcomes they achieve. The potential and promise of AI, and in particular generative AI (GenAI), have captured the world’s attention, but the path to successful implementation can be daunting, as AI technologies and use cases rapidly evolve.

items.title: 3 success factors for moving payments to the public cloud
items.summary: This CGI blog post discusses three success factors for moving payments to the public cloud.

items.title: Global uncertainty underlines the need to accelerate modernization in transport and logistics
items.summary: New market realities are pushing transport organizations to reassess what they must do to stay relevant in the future. As part of the 2022 CGI Voice of Our Clients (VOC), we spoke one-to-one with 84 transport and logistics executives to understand how they are evolving their priorities to move forward. This blog highlights the key findings from the discussions.

items.title: Unlocking the power of data: A global push for healthcare interoperability
items.summary: Healthcare systems frequently struggle to share critical patient data across different platforms and organizations due to varying standards, technologies, connectivity issues, and legacy infrastructure. At CGI, we recognize that achieving true interoperability is essential for enhancing care coordination, reducing medical errors, and improving patient outcomes.

items.title: From assistants to trustworthy AI co-workers: Operationalizing responsible agentic AI
items.summary: Discover recommended practices for adopting agentic AI responsibility in this CGI blog.

items.title: ISO 20022: It’s time to stop focusing on the tracks and look at the train
items.summary: More banks are shifting their focus from the “rails” supporting ISO 20022 adoption to the “trains” riding on those rails, i.e., new ISO 20022-enabled services.

items.title: What successful chief information security officers are doing right
items.summary: The role of the chief information security officer (CISO) has become increasingly mainstream and strategic in recent years. While mandates vary among organizations, the CISO’s role has evolved from being technology focused to one of a business enabler and risk manager.

items.title: Six strategies that make your organization fluid and future ready
items.summary: It requires deeper thought (and some crystal ball gazing) to anticipate the wider impacts of the intersection between AI and other technologies. So how can insurers create a fluid strategy that helps them successfully manage this uncertainty?

items.title: IoT – It’s all about data insights
items.summary: The Internet of Things (IoT) is set to generate vast amounts of new data, with some predictions citing that over 100 billion “things” will send out data over the Internet by 2020. Without new analysis methods, this sheer volume at best risks the value of data being lost and, at worst, may overwhelm a business completely. To make sure we create value from all this data, we need to concentrate on generating insights that businesses can use.

items.title: Revolutionizing healthcare: Navigating the opportunities and challenges of AI integration
items.summary: Governments around the globe are issuing rules and frameworks for responsible artificial intelligence (AI) development and deployment. In the U.S., the landmark Executive Order on Safe, Secure, and Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence underscores the imperative to ensure the safety and security of AI systems, emphasizing the importance of building trust in these technologies. In the EU, the AI Act will be the first comprehensive AI law.

items.title: Future-ready retail: Balancing efficiency, experience and resilience in a shifting world
items.summary: 2025 CGI Voice of Clients: Technology modernization, data-driven insights and operational excellence underpin retailers’ success amid market uncertainty For years, retail organizations have felt the impact of major macro trends reshaping the global landscape. The fight against climate change, shifts in world economic order, demographic changes, and rapid digital acceleration have all gradually redefined how the industry operates.

items.title: Bridging strategy and execution: Overcoming OCIO challenges to deliver real business value
items.summary: As organizations accelerate their digital journeys, many business leaders are discovering that aligning IT strategy with business outcomes is easier said than done. The Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO) plays a critical role in making this connection and delivering business value.

items.title: Embracing AI: The key to accelerating and revolutionizing drug development
items.summary: Conversations at BIO centered around the integration of AI in drug discovery. The key decision facing project teams across the industry is clear: embracing AI to accelerate and revolutionize drug development is the key to future success.

items.title: Navigating change: Why managed services make sense for insurance carriers
items.summary: The property and casualty insurance industry continues to face economic pressures, talent shortages, and the need to adapt quickly in a climate of rapid change. According to our latest Voice of Our Clients research, difficulty hiring IT talent continues to be a top challenge across the industry. Many carriers struggle to train talent fast enough to keep pace with digital modernization requirements and changing customer expectations.

items.title: Why supply chains require an ecosystem mindset
items.summary: Behind every item lies a complex, interconnected global supply chain ecosystem that must work in perfect harmony to ensure that the products and services we rely on are always within reach.

items.title: The convergence of financial crime controls for real-time payments
items.summary: Learn how an AI-powered, unified risk architecture enables banks to secure real-time payments, driving resilience and growth.

items.title: Insights into why cybersecurity and resilience are at the top of the executive agenda
items.summary: Insights into why cybersecurity and resilience are at the top of the executive agenda A dynamic and dangerous landscape Insights from across the globe The importance of threat avoidance

items.title: Liquidity management, as we know it today, will change
items.summary: The global march toward real-time payments continues to accelerate. While banks prepare to make this a reality for their customers, one important factor is often overlooked—the issue of liquidity management.

items.title: Supply chain control towers: an (untapped) strategic tool to empower employees
items.summary: In today’s fast-paced and complex business landscape, resilient, sustainable and customer-centric supply chains are crucial for businesses to thrive. An innovative solution that has gained prominence in recent years is the supply chain control tower.

items.summary: This blog discusses the certificate approach to securing the connected car, which also could benefit other modes of transportation, as well as healthcare, roadw

items.title: Digital Twins: The power to bring the factory to life
items.summary: Digital twin technology is not new. But this technology has increasingly gained traction over the last few years, from digital twins of whole cities and airplane engines to cars and bridges. This blog answers some key questions about digital twins and how using them to visualize and simulate decisions—before acting on them—helps manufacturers accelerate value creation.

items.title: AI agents don’t create value: They reveal what you value
items.summary: AI agents don’t just automate decisions—they amplify an organization’s priorities, values, and trade-offs at scale.

items.title: Mobilizing the data revolution in energy
items.summary: There is a revolution underway in the oil and gas industry. This sector has decades of experience in collecting and analyzing all kinds of data — from seismic data to data from the pump where you fill up or recharge your car.

items.title: Good news for corporate and transaction banks: Corporates are turning away from non-banks
items.summary: Despite the market hype that FinTechs and other non-banks are encroaching on the market share of banks, this is not the case within the corporate and transaction banking market. There has been an 83% drop in non-bank usage among corporates in the past year, according to our latest sponsored survey with GTNews.

items.title: Six ways telcos can outpace their competitors
items.summary: Telcos are under pressure to remain competitive due to challenges from both industry incumbents and new tech entrants, as well as customer demands and regulatory requirements. To address these pressures, this blog provides six ways for telcos to accelerate profitable growth and stay competitive.

items.title: The trend toward pay-as-you-drive insurance
items.summary: Almost every insurance company is currently working on providing pay-as-you-drive insurance. Some already have succeeded in launching it, while others are busy preparing to go to market.

items.title: Modernizing the bank: A look at key strategies and technologies
items.summary: Modernization affects all aspects of a bank, not just the bank’s IT management and spend. It changes a bank’s organization, customer interactions, culture, and products and services. Banks spend, on average, 7% of their revenue on IT, which is higher than most other sectors. Historically, no one has really questioned this amount, but it has come under increasing scrutiny. Does it represent value for the money?

items.title: Unlocking collaborative data ecosystems with Catena-X
items.summary: The automotive industry is at a crossroads, facing challenges that demand collaboration, innovation and adaptability. Catena-X is a pioneering initiative redefining how companies share data and work together. With nearly 200 organizations already on board, including major manufacturers like BMW, Mercedes-Benz, and Volkswagen, Catena-X is rapidly gaining momentum and setting the standard for data ecosystems in the automotive sector and other industries as well.

items.title: Navigating perpetual healthcare challenges with new thinking and innovation
items.summary: Reflecting on my journey in the healthcare sector—from my years as a practitioner, through my tenures as U.S. Army Surgeon General and Secretary of Veterans Affairs, to my time in industry with CGI—I’m struck by the seismic shifts impacting public and private health systems and their stakeholders.

items.title: Using the online marketplace to enhance customer experience
items.summary: The online marketplace provides retailers with an opportunity to strengthen their DNA and offer customers a seamless and complementary product and service offering with limited risk. Assurances for tech products (replacements, refunds or extended warranties) naturally come to mind, such as those offered by the Fnac Darty Group, a European retailer of entertainment and leisure products, consumer electronics and household appliances, or even credit solutions for more expensive products.

items.title: Optimization, GenAI and quantum: Making complex supply chain decisions faster and more accessible
items.summary: The most challenging part of optimization isn’t running the model. It’s building a model that reflects business realities fast enough to support operational decisions.

items.title: Will PSD3 revolutionize European payments?
items.summary: This CGI blog post discusses the impact of PSD3 on European payments.

items.title: From legacy to results: How life sciences leaders deliver ROI with two-speed transformation
items.summary: Digital transformation in life sciences rarely unfolds at a single pace. In the same organization, one team might deploy advanced AI-driven analytics to predict outcomes in seconds, while another relies on production systems installed decades ago.

items.title: Driving more strategic IT governance, risk and compliance across the enterprise
items.summary: CGI recommends addressing these challenges with minimal impact to resource capacity through automation and optimization such as IT governance, risk and compliance (GRC). IT GRC tools provide software and processes that support an integrated approach for identifying and minimizing cyber risk, while also improving compliance and operational efficiency.

items.title: What personal health strategies can teach us about utility asset health (part 1)
items.summary: Studies on corporate wellness programs have shown that companies that proactively focus on improving employee health and well-being see significant benefits including a reduction in lost work days and employee healthcare costs. One of the key drivers of success for wellness programs is the proactive nature of monitoring and managing lifestyle factors such as nutrition and fitness.

items.title: Building long-term transformational outsourcing relationships: An insurance success story
items.summary: Insurers, like organizations in most sectors, are under pressure to transform their businesses using modern technologies like digital, mobile, cloud, etc., but face the constraints of decades-old legacy environments and limited funds to invest in modernization. The challenge is to reduce the costs of running their businesses and re-allocate the savings to digital transformation.

items.title: Privacy by design: Integrating data protection best practices in AI solutions development
items.summary: While Data Privacy Day is a great opportunity to reinforce data protection best practices, privacy by design needs to be practiced 24/7 throughout the year.

items.title: How to consolidate vendors without disrupting your business
items.summary: Discover practical insights and recommendations for consolidating vendors while keeping your business running smoothly in this CGI blog.

items.title: The AI token economy: Managing the hidden costs of agentic AI
items.summary: The AI token economy is reshaping enterprise technology spending. Learn how to manage the hidden costs of agentic AI.
